correctness.rationale: Two complementary closure steps prove the P/N partition for all finite binary words: no proposed P-position has a legal P-option and every other position has a constructive legal move into P. Stars-and-bars gives the finite count, regular-language product gives the rational OGF, and a length-reduction mex induction plus alternating-word options yields exact maximal Grundy floor(n/2). The leading root of the enumerator gives exponential decay. An actual-game exhaustive mex checker through length 17 and an independent coefficient checker through length 200 replay successfully; neither is substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The opposite two-letter triggers ab and ba are a minimal genuinely overlapping word-trigger instance of the explicit two-ended generalization question in arXiv:2611.09157. A complete regular-language description, canonical linear-time winning move, exact enumerator, and every-length sharp maximum Grundy provide structural and enumerative content beyond a textbook P/N example. The Dyck-versus-regular contrast illustrates a substantive effect of changing from one-letter to overlapping two-letter triggers, without claiming the general problem is solved.
